Name: DDs Greenhouse
Author: DevilishDemigod
Description:
A custom greenhouse that I have made for myself. There are three 15x15, two 2x8, two 2x24, and forty-eight 1x1 tillable plots.

3x 15x15: 675 tillable tiles
2x 2x8: 32 tillable tiles (quality line sprinklers)
2x 2x24: 96 tillable tiles (iridium line sprinklers)
OR
803 tillable tiles for crops

48x: 48 tillable plots for individual trees

[b]LOFT & CELLAR:[/b] v1.1 includes a new version of the Greenhouse that includes a loft above and cellar (capable of casks) below. To change to this version, navigate to your mods folder and open the config file with a text editor. Change "DDs" to "Cellar" and vice versa if wishing to switch. The Loft and Cellar maps will always exist, the config file change simple chooses between the greenhouse allowing the access points or not. The default is the non loft and cellar version.
(C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\DDs Greenhouse\config)

[b][color=#ff0000]WARNING:[/color][/b] This mod will overwrite the greenhouse.tmx file. I highly suggest an empty greenhouse before loading this mod.

[b]INSTALL VORTEX:[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Vortex appears to work. Select "Mod Manager Download"
[/list][b]INSTALL MANUAL:[/b][list=1]
[*]Install the latest versions of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip/extract the folder in your [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.
[/list]
